crucialFeats: Bound the Butcher inside his power battery.
Kept fighting after his heart was removed.
Martian Manhunter cannot attack him telepathically.
Burned through the fabric of space with rage plasma.

dossier.advantage: A red ring instead of a heart and inhuman strength. The ring keeps him alive even after fatal wounds, and his physical power lets him crush energy barriers with his bare hands.
dossier.mentality: A furious zealot driven by revenge. He knows no mercy or hesitation - he advances with a rage that grows stronger the more hatred and anger the opponent shows.
dossier.quote: I am Atrocitus, lord and master of the Red Lantern Corps. I am wrath, I am hate, I am righteous vengeance!
dossier.style: Brutal, primal aggression. Atrocitus charges opponents to tear them apart with his bare hands, backed by corrosive rage plasma.

fighterA.name: Atrocitus

powers: Red Lantern plasma emission, constructs, blood magic and rituals, flight, and Butcher-linked rage dynamics.
tools: Emotional-spectrum manipulation and heavy ranged pressure.
Ability to poison an opponent's power or energy through contact with blood and plasma.
weaknesses: Prolonged direct brawls can reduce his tactical edge in favor of the opponent's raw strength.

victories: Saint Walker, Indigo-1 and Star Sapphire

crucialFeats: World Breaker scale enables collateral destruction of a planet and moon.
A clash between Worldbreaker Red She-Hulk and World Breaker Hulk fractured a planet.
Nearly sank the entire east coast with a single step.

dossier.advantage: Unlimited strength growth and regeneration. The more hurt and angry he becomes, the stronger he gets, making him nearly unbeatable in attrition.
dossier.mentality: A stubborn, savage destroyer. He does not calculate or retreat - he pushes forward until all resistance is leveled.
dossier.style: Unstoppable close-quarters destruction. He relies on pure physical force and nonstop forward pressure, crushing everything under his strikes.

fighterB.name: Hulk

powers: Rage-driven strength growth, regeneration, shockwaves, and extreme stamina.
tools: Gamma radiation output (in World Breaker mode), destroying everything nearby.
weaknesses: Limited long-range utility against dedicated control specialists.
His strategic options narrow sharply when he cannot maintain sustained contact.

battle-dynamics.label: Absolute Rage
battle-dynamics.phase_1: Atrocitus devours Hulk's rage from the first second. Every roar from the Green Goliath only fuels the Red Ring.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Atrocitus's plasma burns the very fabric of space. Hulk loses footing, and his biological regeneration has nothing left to rebuild.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Conceptual dominance. Atrocitus suppresses Hulk's rage, shutting down his 'engine' and erasing him from reality.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Against the host of the Butcher, Hulk is merely infinite fuel. Atrocitus controls every aspect of this annihilation.

fight-simulation.label: Final Verdict
fight-simulation.opening: Atrocitus charges, but instead of striking, he simply starts inhaling Hulk's fury.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Hulk erupts with gamma energy, which is instantly consumed and converted into red-light constructs.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Atrocitus releases plasma that tears a hole in reality, pulling the disoriented opponent into it.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Atrocitus wins by conceptually erasing the opponent.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Atrocitus activates Butcher-Sync, turning Hulk's rage into his own fuel.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: The space around the warriors becomes boiling plasma that dissolves matter.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Hulk tries to escape the trap, but has no foothold.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Hulk's body starts decaying at the atomic level.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Atrocitus uses Rage Suppression, reverting Hulk to Banner inside the blast epicenter.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Bruce Banner is erased from existence.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: The universe is cleansed of the gamma anomaly.

final-summary.line_1: Both warriors feed on rage, but Atrocitus turns it into control while Hulk turns it into raw destructive scale.
final-summary.line_2: Atrocitus with the Butcher is an absolute hard counter to Hulk. The more Hulk fights, the faster he loses.
final-summary.line_3: This clash asks whether a life-sustaining ring can survive at the core of an atomic blast - Atrocitus proves it can.

tactical-board.lane: Atrocitus must keep the fight under ring control before Hulk turns it into a gamma loop.
tactical-board.subtitle: Butcher versus Worldbreaker

verdict-matrix.subtitle: Conceptual annihilation vs lucky shot
verdict-matrix.case_1: Atrocitus 9/10. Even though World Breaker Hulk is the pinnacle of physical force, he is a conceptual victim of Atrocitus. The Red Ring not only lets Atrocitus feed on Hulk's rage, but also provides the rare ability of Rage Suppression. Atrocitus can literally switch off Hulk's fury, reverting him to Bruce Banner with a single act of will. Combined with space-burning plasma and no need to breathe, Atrocitus completely controls the clash. Hulk retains only a 1/10 chance through absolute luck - if he could destroy the Lantern ring with one desperate blow before full spectrum control activates.

x-factor.implikacja: Atrocitus wins because the opponent's rage is fuel, not a threat.
x-factor.mechanika: Atrocitus has the conceptual edge of switching off Hulk's engine through rage suppression.
x-factor.psychologia: Hulk does not realize that every second of fighting makes him conceptually weaker against the Lantern.
